headline: Nevish Line Aflame; Linn Mercy Works Slip to No-Man's-Land
war_summary: Fighting on the Nevish Line has redrawn that front since the last edition. Where eight of eight works stood in Warden hands, the desk now counts five Warden, two Colonial and one unclaimed, with forty-three actions logged in the day and fifteen in the past two hours alone; roughly 900 Colonial and 740 Warden casualties fell there in the last hour. Linn Mercy has lost two more works to no-man's-land — eight Colonial and three unclaimed remain — while its guns accelerate. The Weathered Expanse has yielded a Warden work to Colonial hands, leaving three Warden, two Colonial and four unclaimed; fifty-two actions were counted there over the day. In Marban Hollow the Wardens have clawed back ground, now holding four works to three Colonial, with a single patch unclaimed. Callahan's Passage remains the bloodiest posting, near 850 Colonial and 420 Warden casualties in the past hour, yet its ten Warden works stand unchanged. The wider map remains largely Colonial, with Warden strength massed in the north and west.
